caption: The drawing depicts a spinning wheel, constructed primarily of wood with a natural brown color. The spinning wheel consists of several key parts: a large wheel with six spokes on the right side, which is connected via a drive band to a smaller, cylindrical flyer mechanism mounted horizontally on the upper left side. The wheel is supported by a wooden frame with turned legs and crossbars, forming a bench-like base with three legs visible, two in the front and one in the back. The lower part of the frame contains a rectangular treadle with parallel slats, which is connected to the rest of the mechanism by a wooden rod. The entire spinning wheel is shown in a three-quarter perspective, and the image is set against a plain, beige background. The artist's name, "V. Rigil Liberto," is printed in small letters near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Spinning Wheel
